newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 24.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- China tells journalists not to accept money to print news
- Customs Administration takes measures to halt evasion
- Tobacco growing area to be controlled at under 1.334 million hectares in 1997.
- Central bank governor Dai Xianglong meets visiting head of New York reserve
- China's southwestern Yunnan province produced 12.46 tonnes of grain, 11.3 million tonnes of sugar cane and 860,000 tonnes of tobacco in 1996.
- China increases central control over fertiliser imports and scraps subsidies on imports.
- China's import of cars dip by 41.7 percent in 1996 to 920,000 vehicles.
- China's Heavy Duty Machinery Corp wins order to provide production lines for General Motors assembly line.
- China sales of fertiliser reach 94.36 million tonnes in 1996, up eight percent from 1995.
